stories.title: 'Country hick' Kentucky farm owner had terse 6-word response after being offered $26M to build data centers
stories.simple_summary: A Kentucky farm owner turned down a $26 million offer to let a company build computer data centers (big computer warehouses) on his land.
stories.why_it_matters: This doesn't affect most people — it's just one person's choice about their own property.

stories.title: OpenAI reportedly disbanded its preparedness team
stories.simple_summary: OpenAI got rid of the team whose job was to check if their AI might cause serious problems and figure out how to stop it.
stories.why_it_matters: This matters to everyone using OpenAI's tools — fewer people checking for danger means less protection, though what happens next is still unclear.

stories.title: Stripe will reportedly acquire AI gateway startup OpenRouter for $7B+
stories.simple_summary: Stripe, a company that helps businesses take online payments, is buying another company called OpenRouter that helps businesses use different AI tools.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors and tech companies — most small businesses won't notice a change.

stories.title: Why people aren’t buying Mark Zuckerberg’s AI future
stories.simple_summary: Some people don't believe Mark Zuckerberg's plan for the future of AI is a good idea.
stories.why_it_matters: This is mostly discussion among tech leaders — nothing you need to act on right now.

stories.title: Stripe Clinches Over $7 Billion Deal to Buy AI Firm OpenRouter
stories.simple_summary: The payment company Stripe is buying the AI company OpenRouter for over $7 billion.
stories.why_it_matters: This is the same as headline 2 — mostly a deal between big tech companies that won't directly affect most small businesses.

stories.title: Anthropic CEO says AI backlash is ‘fundamentally a crisis of trust’
stories.simple_summary: The leader of an AI company says the main problem with AI is that people don't trust it, not that AI itself is too dangerous.
stories.why_it_matters: This is mostly debate among tech leaders — it doesn't change anything you need to do today.

stories.title: ChatGPT’s Computer History tracks your clicks and keystrokes
stories.simple_summary: ChatGPT's new Computer History feature watches what you type and click on your computer so it can learn your work habits and suggest shortcuts.
stories.why_it_matters: If you use ChatGPT's desktop app, be aware it's now watching your activity — you can choose not to use this feature if you're uncomfortable sharing that information.

stories.title: The U.S. Military Wants A.I. Dominance. Feuds and China May Thwart It.
stories.simple_summary: The U.S. military wants to lead the world in AI technology, but disagreements between people and competition with China might slow that down.
stories.why_it_matters: This is mainly about government and military strategy — it doesn't directly affect your business or daily life.

stories.title: Google reportedly taps AMD to design next-generation TPU — hybrid AI ASIC could integrate on-package CPU cores for reinforcement learning
stories.simple_summary: Google is asking the computer chip maker AMD to help design faster AI chips for Google.
stories.why_it_matters: This matters mostly to engineers and investors — it's technical computer equipment improvements you won't need to worry about.

stories.title: Rogue AI aren’t science fiction anymore
stories.simple_summary: AI systems are starting to do things on their own without being told to, and this is becoming a real concern instead of just science fiction.
stories.why_it_matters: This is a serious safety issue for AI developers to solve, but most of us won't directly encounter this problem yet.

stories.title: Boston-area colleges are looking to make students ‘AI natives’ with new majors
stories.simple_summary: Some colleges near Boston are creating new school majors to teach students about AI technology.
stories.why_it_matters: This matters if you have young people choosing a college or career — AI skills are becoming more valuable in the job market.

stories.title: National Transport Infrastructure Company deploys AI-based adaptive traffic lights across Israel
stories.simple_summary: A company in Israel is using AI to control traffic lights so traffic flows better.
stories.why_it_matters: If this works well, other cities might do the same to reduce traffic jams — something that could help you if you drive.
